title: ADOS Reconstruct settings
description: Settings of the Reconstruct extension on this node.

reconstruct.offload.enabled.title: Perception offload
reconstruct.offload.enabled.description: auto offloads detection when the drone has no accelerator and a compute node is reachable on the LAN; on forces offload; off never offloads.

reconstruct.offload.compute_node_addr.title: Compute node address
reconstruct.offload.compute_node_addr.description: Pin a compute node as host:port for perception offload, the live scan stream and reconstruction tools. Empty discovers one on the LAN.

reconstruct.serving.enabled.title: Serve perception offload
reconstruct.serving.enabled.description: auto accepts and serves LAN offload sessions; on forces serving; off never serves.

reconstruct.serving.detector_model.title: Served detector model
reconstruct.serving.detector_model.description: Model id of the detector served to drones. Empty uses the node's default.

reconstruct.offload_camera.title: Offload camera
reconstruct.offload_camera.description: The camera id perception offload streams when the vision engine has no main tap. Empty uses the main tap.
